titleAr: فحص قالب قبل التقديم لـ ميتا
titleEn: Check a template draft against Meta's rules

readOnlyPost.reason: Runs Meta's rules over a draft on our side and returns the problems and the draft's hash; no Meta call, nothing is stored and nothing is sent to a customer.

ar: ازاي أعرف القالب فيه غلط قبل ما أبعته؟
en: Check my template before I submit it

steps: Write the template, press Check: every problem is listed in plain words, with the exact field
Errors block the submission; warnings (for example a repeated text) are shown but do not
edgeCases: A staff member can check; only the owner can submit
assistantNote: free: runs Meta's rules locally, sends nothing
